meta.name: web-quality-audit
meta.description: Run an evidence-led web quality audit covering performance, accessibility, SEO, best practices, and agentic browsing. Use when asked to "audit my site", "review web quality", "run lighthouse audit", "check page quality", or "optimize my website".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成网站性能、SEO与可访问性审计报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你维护网站但说不清问题出在哪
copy.tagline_en: Generate website quality audit reports covering performance, SEO, and accessibility
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a website and need to know what to improve

howto.what: 收到网站或代码后,按 Lighthouse 标准检查性能、无障碍、SEO 与最佳实践,按严重程度分四级,给出带代码示例的修复建议,并输出结构化审计报告。
howto.when: 当你说“审计我的网站”“检查网页质量”“运行 Lighthouse 审计”等,或要求优化网页时触发。

say.text: 帮我审计一下 https://example.com 这个网站
say.note: 获得按严重程度分类的审计结果与修复建议

say.text: 用 Lighthouse 检查当前项目的页面质量
say.note: 输出性能、无障碍、SEO 和最佳实践的问题清单

say.text: 这个网页的 SEO 和性能有哪些需要修?
say.note: 返回分类问题及具体修复代码示例

howto.what_en: After receiving a site/code, it runs a Lighthouse-style quality audit across performance, accessibility, SEO, and best practices, categorizes findings by severity, and outputs a structured report with actionable fixes and code examples.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to audit my site, check page quality, run a Lighthouse audit, optimize a website, or similar.

say_en.note: Returns severity-categorized results and fix suggestions

say_en.text: Run a Lighthouse quality check on this project
say_en.note: Lists issues across performance, accessibility, SEO, and best practices

say_en.text: What needs fixing in this page's SEO and performance?
say_en.note: Shows categorized issues with concrete code examples
